# OpenCounseling Blog

> A comprehensive mental health resource platform connecting people with therapists, crisis support, and public mental health services across the United States and internationally.

OpenCounseling provides practical guides, directories, and search tools to help individuals find mental health support. The site covers therapist matching, crisis hotlines, license verification, and state-by-state mental health service information.

## Key Topics

## Therapist Search & Matching

- [Find a Therapist - OpenCounseling](https://blog.opencounseling.com/location_search): Therapist search tool with location-based matching for in-person and online therapy

## Crisis Support & Hotlines

- [Free Telephone Counseling Hotlines in the United States](https://blog.opencounseling.com/hotlines-us): Directory of free US crisis hotlines including 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
- [International Suicide Hotlines](https://blog.opencounseling.com/suicide-hotlines): Global directory of international suicide and emergency crisis hotlines

## Mental Health Services & Resources

- [The United States Mental Health Services Guide](https://blog.opencounseling.com/public-mental-health-us): Comprehensive state-by-state guide to US public mental health services and resources

## Therapist Verification & Licensing

- [Look Up a Therapist's License - A State-by-State Guide](https://blog.opencounseling.com/check-a-therapist-license): State-by-state guide to verify therapist licenses and check disciplinary records
